obernants.operator: Successful results cannot omit input bytes, contain gap-gap columns, or have a suboptimal score. This is global linear-gap byte alignment; there are no affine gaps, local alignment or sequence-specific assumptions.

obernants.operator: Strict greater-than replacement preserves diagonal on a tie; deletion wins a deletion/insertion tie when diagonal is worse. This local traceback rule selects one optimal path, not a lexicographically minimum forward alignment.
